title: Mushroom 'Meat' Cowboy Quesadillas
subtitle: with Corn and Coriander
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Finely chop the onion. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the corn.

Start filling: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, coriander stems and garlic, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the mushroom meat and cook, breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 2 mins or until starting to brown. Add 1½ tbs water and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until browned.

Simmer filling: Add the Tex-Mex seasoning and half the tomato paste to the mushroom meat mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Add the corn and 60ml (¼ cup) water and bring to the boil. Cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until the liquid is absorbed. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Bake quesadillas: Divide the filling among the tortillas. Fold the tortillas over to enclose the filling, pressing together firmly (see Make it cheesy). Put the quesadillas on the lined tray and lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake the quesadillas for 10-12 mins until golden and crisp.

Serve up: Combine 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tbs water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Divide the quesadillas among plates, scatter over the coriander leaves and dip or drizzle with the mayonnaise mixture. Enjoy!
Make it cheesy: Got some cheese on hand? Scatter grated cheddar over the tortillas before folding and baking for a cheesy twist.
